label: Services
description: The full menu by category, the first visit and questions.

settings.heading: The *menu*
settings.text: Every treatment, its time and its price. Prices marked from depend on length and thickness.

settings.heading: Arrive ten minutes early
settings.text: There is tea in the front room and a form to fill in.

settings.heading: Tell us everything
settings.text: Pressure, allergies, a sore shoulder, a wedding on the calendar. It all helps.

settings.heading: Settle in
settings.text: Robes, lockers and a quiet room before your treatment.

settings.heading: Take the day slowly
settings.text: Drink water, skip the gym, keep the glow.

settings.question: What should I wear?
settings.answer: Whatever is comfortable. We have robes, slippers and lockers, and you undress to your own comfort.

settings.question: Can I come in pregnant?
settings.answer: Yes. Noor gives prenatal massage side-lying with a bolster, from the second trimester on. Tell us when you book.

settings.question: Do you take walk-ins?
settings.answer: When a room is free, yes. Text us first and we will tell you.

settings.question: How do I cancel or reschedule?
settings.answer: Text or call a day ahead and there is no charge.

settings.question: Which products do you use?
settings.answer: The ones on our shelves: Alder & Co. in the salon, Still Water in the treatment rooms and Nettle oils for massage.
